summary: As an experienced web support agency, Lancashire Web Designers provides ongoing technical maintenance and proactive care for mission-critical business websites. We protect your digital investment with 24/7 uptime monitoring, daily off-site cloud backups, regular core security patching, Core Web Vitals performance tuning, and responsive developer support whenever you need site updates.
benefits: Proactive security patching protecting your site from malware and vulnerabilities
Automated 24/7 uptime monitoring with rapid emergency incident response
Daily off-site cloud backups with single-click disaster recovery guarantees
Monthly performance audits maintaining sub-second mobile page speeds
Dedicated developer hours every month for content updates, tweaks, and feature additions

process.title: Initial Codebase & Security Onboarding Audit
process.description: We perform a thorough forensic inspection of your website code, plugins, hosting environment, and DNS records to resolve latent vulnerabilities.

process.title: Automated Backup & Monitoring Implementation
process.description: Configuring real-time uptime health checks, automated database backups to secure European cloud storage, and firewall protection layers.

process.title: Staging Environment & Safe Updates
process.description: All core and plugin updates are applied and regression-tested on a private staging replica before deploying to your production environment.

process.title: Continuous Optimization & Speed Tuning
process.description: Monthly caching adjustments, image compression checks, database table defragmentation, and broken link remediation.

process.title: Transparent Monthly Reporting
process.description: Receiving an executive summary detailing uptime metrics, security scans, completed tasks, and strategic performance recommendations.

whatsIncluded: 24/7 automated uptime and SSL certificate monitoring
Daily automated off-site backups with 30-day retention
Managed security updates and vulnerability patching in staging first
Dedicated developer support time for content changes and new features

priceNotes: Monthly care plans start at £99/month for standard brochure sites, scaling to £249/month for complex ecommerce or high-traffic platforms.

faqs.question: Can you support a website that you didn't build originally?
faqs.answer: Yes. We regularly take over management of existing WordPress, WooCommerce, or custom sites built by other agencies. We begin with a comprehensive onboarding audit to review code quality, remove dormant plugins, and establish reliable backup routines.

faqs.question: What happens if our website goes offline outside business hours?
faqs.answer: Our automated monitoring checks your site every 60 seconds from multiple global locations. If an outage is detected, automated alerts notify our on-call engineering team immediately to diagnose and restore service.

faqs.question: What can I use my included monthly developer hours for?
faqs.answer: You can use your allocated time for anything you need: publishing new case studies, adding team members, updating pricing, testing new landing page variations, adding interactive forms, or installing analytics tracking tags.

faqs.question: Are there long-term contracts or cancellation penalties?
faqs.answer: No. Our website care plans run on a rolling 30-day agreement. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel at any time with 30 days notice.
